as_of: Data as of the US close on
footer_numbers: Every number comes from a data API. Nothing on this page is written by an AI.
footer_price_only: Changes are price only, without dividends (split-adjusted closes), so they match what Yahoo and Google display.
footer_sources: Prices: Yahoo Finance via yfinance. Rates: US Treasury daily par yield curve (same day), FRED as fallback (one business day lag). Each row shows its own value date.
heatmap_legend: Box size: market cap. Color: 1 day change (blue up, red down). Grouped by GICS sector.
heatmap_skipped: not shown (no market cap or price)
slow_movers_intro: S&P 500 stocks that crossed a long-term threshold on the last trading day, computed from price history. One alert per ticker; inside 90 days a ticker returns only on a higher severity or another 20% move. Sorted by severity, then market cap.
no_slow_movers: No stock crossed a threshold on the last trading day.
suppressed: held back (cooldown, or lower severity than the last alert)
baseline_intro: Every S&P 500 stock currently beyond a slow mover threshold, as of the last close. This is the starting point; the daily brief only reports new crossings.
breadth_line: S&P 500 stocks at a 52 week low vs high
earnings_intro: S&P 500 companies whose 8-K with Item 2.02 (results of operations) was accepted between the previous close and this close.
no_earnings: No S&P 500 company filed results for this trading day.
scanned_note: 8-K filings found for this trading day
chunk_macro: Monday: macro and the week ahead
chunk_business: Tuesday: how the company makes money (10-K Item 1)
not_reported: not reported with the usual tags (banks and REITs report differently)
week_changes: What changed over the last week
competitor_table: Latest fiscal year from company facts
deep_dive_failed: This chunk could not be built
partial_chunk: Part of this chunk is missing
ongoing_intro: Every ticker inside the slow mover cooldown, with its first alert of the current streak and how far it has moved since.
no_ongoing: No ticker is inside the cooldown.
